blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The five-member Philippine triathlon team opens its Asian Games 2026 campaign Sunday at Gamagori City Triathlon venue in Aichi Prefecture, Japan. The team, which underwent a after completing course familiarization. held international training camps in Spain, Indonesia and China before arriving in Japan. “They are all sharp and battle-ready,” Triathlon Philippines President Tom Carrasco said. Fernando Casares, a two-time individual Southeast Asian Games champion, leads the men’s team with Kim Remolino and Inaki Lorbes. The men’s race is scheduled for 8:30 a.m. Japan time.
